overview: The Medford School Committee met to honor student and staff achievements, approve the amended 2026-2027 school calendar, and table updates to the district handbook. The Committee also accepted a $50,000 donation from Tufts University and approved policies on student travel and a special education reserve fund.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The Committee voted to enter executive session to discuss collective bargaining with the Massachusetts Teachers Association and Teamsters Local 25, as well as strategy for non-union personnel contract negotiations.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: The Committee approved the consent agenda, which included bill and payroll approvals, a donation to the McGlynn Library, and meeting minutes from May 18, 2026.

items.title: Mustang Moments Student Recognitions
items.summary: The Committee recognized student achievements including the Medford Children's Art Showcase, the three-time state champion Mario Kart esports team, and multiple humanities award honorees.

items.title: CPAC Executive Board Retirements
items.summary: The Committee recognized and thanked retiring Special Education Parent Advisory Council (CPAC) executive board members Tanya Sullivan, Alex Larick, Anne Herzog-Rousseau, and Jamil Anne Johnson for ten years of service.

items.title: Staff Retirements and Employee Anniversaries
items.summary: The Committee honored retiring school district staff and recognized current employees reaching milestone anniversaries of 25, 30, and 40 years of service.

items.title: Tufts University Donation and MFN Founder Recognition
items.summary: The Committee accepted a $50,000 donation from Tufts University to the Medford Family Network in honor of its retiring founder, Marie Cassidy.

items.title: Amended 2026-2027 District Calendar
items.summary: The Committee approved the amended 2026-2027 school year calendar, resolving scheduling challenges around Good Friday and adjusting the date for Eid al-Fitr.

items.title: Updated Medford Public Schools Handbook
items.summary: The Committee discussed and tabled the updated district handbook to incorporate requested edits regarding recess policies, AI grading guidelines, and academic dishonesty panel compositions.

items.title: Resolution 2026-12: Policy JJH Student Travel Update
items.summary: The Committee approved on first reading an update to student travel policy JJH to establish an approval process for out-of-state field trips occurring between regular meetings.

items.title: Resolution 2026-13: Special Education Reserve Fund
items.summary: The Committee approved a resolution, as amended, to establish a special education reserve fund to offset unanticipated or unbudgeted costs.
